item.title: Documentation as Tooling - The Ops Tool
item.description: 1. What Documentation as Tooling Means “Documentation as tooling, tooling as a product” is a slogan I have repeated many times in my previous blog posts. item.title: How to Package a Python Package and Upload It to PyPI
item.description: Recently I have been thinking about how to improve development efficiency. From web crawlers to data processing, and then to artificial intelligence, Python’s strength lies in having a large set of out-of-the-box toolkits, so you do not have to reinvent the wheel, which greatly improves development efficiency. So why not modularize the functional pieces of a project and package them as reusable Python packages?
